title: FluidsBench submission rehearsed on an exact reference (AirfRANS-shaped supports)
description: The FluidsBench participant path end to end - contract read from a checkout of the benchmark's submission repository, a benchmark-owned scoring support verified by its digest chain, native predictions mapped onto the canonical entities, the published relative-L2 reductions with additive sufficient statistics, the composite score, a schema-v3 result package rebuilt from its own numbers, and a submit/review trust decision - on potential flow around a cylinder, whose closed-form solution makes every number on the way checkable. Three angles of attack are trained on, one is held out inside the training range and two outside it (the AoA extrapolation protocol).
methods: exact potential flow around a cylinder (zero-parameter reference)

metrics.name: submissions_written
metrics.how: one package per model family per split, each validated by recomputing its digest chain, its relative L2 from its own sufficient statistics, its macro-average and its composite

metrics.name: packages_validating
metrics.how: pinneapple_arena.fluidsbench.validate_package on every package, no problems reported

metrics.name: oracle_relative_l2
metrics.how: the reference field scored against itself through the full path; must be zero for the mapping, the reductions and the composite to be consistent

metrics.name: oracle_overall_score
metrics.how: the published composite of the oracle package: every component error is zero

metrics.name: best_overall_score_holdout
metrics.how: composite of the best package on the hold-out angle 4.0 deg (transolver, 60 epochs)

metrics.name: best_surface_pressure_rel_l2_holdout
metrics.how: length-weighted relative L2 on the wall curve, macro-averaged over the hold-out case (transolver)

metrics.name: best_velocity_rel_l2_holdout
metrics.how: unweighted relative L2 of the velocity vector on the 2-D domain, macro-averaged over the hold-out case (transolver)

metrics.name: extrapolation_reviewed
metrics.how: trust decisions of the AoA-extrapolation split: cases outside the training range are reported as review, never as submit

metrics.name: holdout_submitted
metrics.how: trust decisions of the hold-out split, whose case lies inside the training range

metrics.name: stagnation_pressure
metrics.how: p at the stagnation point of the reference, asserted equal to half the squared freestream speed

metrics.name: wall_speed_max
metrics.how: largest wall speed of the reference, asserted equal to twice the freestream speed

metrics.name: wall_time_seconds
metrics.how: the whole rehearsal on this machine

metrics.name: best_overall_score_extrapolation
metrics.how: composite of the best package on the AoA-extrapolation split (12 and 20 deg, outside the training range): the same models degrade there

checks.name: the reference scored against itself gives zero relative L2 and overall_score 100
every result package validates against its own numbers
the support release digest chain verifies against the contract it was read with

maximum wall speed equals twice the freestream speed
the extrapolation split is reported as review, the hold-out split as submit
nothing here is a FluidsBench submission: the support is a rehearsal this example writes
